description: Pittston, PA — Congressman Rob Bresnahan’s campaign today announced that he has earned the endorsement of Boilermakers Local Lodge No. 13, representing skilled tradespeople who build and maintain the critical infrastructure that powers communities across Pennsylvania and the rest of the country.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Rob Bresnahan Earns Endorsement from Boilermakers Local 13 - Rob for PA
